recorded.prompt:q-versioning: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-versioning: `prevent_destroy` on the bucket would not have caught this: the bucket is not destroyed, only its versioning resource, whose block was deleted from the files. The plan check sees the plan, not the files, so it catches it.

recorded.outcome:q-replace: Replacing the compute environment passes: it holds no data, and queued jobs are the only thing to plan around.
